details.description: Yakult is a probiotic fermented milk drink that contains over 6.5 billion beneficial bacteria Lactobacillus casei strain Shirota (LcS) in every bottle. Yakult's bacteria Lactobacillus casei strain Shirota (LcS) reaches the intestine alive and helps improve intestinal function and build immunity. Yakult is sold globally, and over 35 million people enjoy the delicious taste of Yakult.

Yakult Light is a delightfully refreshing probiotic drink that nourishes your digestive system and supports your overall well-being. Crafted with the renowned Lactobacillus casei strain Shirota, this fermented milk beverage delivers more than 6.5 billion beneficial bacteria to your gut, helping to maintain a healthy balance of gut flora. Boasting a reduced sugar content and enriched with essential vitamins D and E, Yakult Light is the perfect choice for those seeking a healthier lifestyle without compromising on taste or quality. Enjoy this light and flavourful drink daily as part of a balanced diet to support your digestive function, strengthen your immunity, and promote a vibrant, youthful vitality. With its carefully curated formula and delightful probiotic properties, Yakult Light is a delicious and nutritious addition to your wellness routine.

details.description: Indulge in the delightful fusion of tropical mango and the gut-nourishing benefits of Yakult's signature Lactobacillus casei Shirota with this probiotic fermented milk drink. Boasting a refreshing and creamy taste, each bottle delivers a boost of 5 billion L. casei Shirota bacteria to support your digestive health and overall immunity. Conveniently packaged for on-the-go enjoyment, this probiotic drink allows you to savour the goodness of probiotics and the delightful mango flavour anytime, anywhere, making it an excellent choice for your daily wellness routine.
